This is an editorial-led TOPIC page, not a neighbourhood page: it defines its subject as "detached houses for sale in Langley that come with a coach house or carriage home: a second, smaller home on the same lot, often above or beside a garage at the back," with the rules explainer above the feed and the listing cards under an "Additional Details" heading at the foot of the page. A coach house is a second dwelling unit on a fee-simple lot — it is not a strata condo, and this page has no apartment-condo stock: states that plainly. The others describe a garden suite (Brookswood), a second home and a cabin on 13.21 acres (Murrayville), a loft apartment in a barn (County Line Glen Valley) and a "legal detached cottage" (Campbell Valley). The page's total feed count is not displayed in the text read, and the exact MLS® feed filter criteria behind the page are not verified.

blocks.text: Local rules that affect condo buyers in Langley Houses with Coach Houses for Sale

items.t: : in Township of Langley Zoning Bylaw No. 2500, s. 102, a coach house is a dwelling unit on the second storey of a detached garage only.

: Zoning Bylaw s. 102, as amended, caps a Township secondary suite at 120 m² with no percentage cap. The Township's January 2025 secondary-suites guide states suites are not permitted in townhouses/rowhouses, while the current s. 102 definition (July 2025) states a suite may be located in a townhouse or rowhouse — both documents are reported here with their dates; a buyer relying on either point should confirm with the Township.

Zoning Amendment Bylaw No. 6020 (SSMUH), adopted November 18, 2024 — eligible lots (Urban Containment Boundary, municipal water and sewer, not heritage-designated, not in a Transit-Oriented Area) may have 3 units at ≤280 m² or 4 units at 280–4,050 m²; lots over 4,050 m² are ineligible and the Township has no six-unit tier. Properties that do not qualify are instead eligible for one unit plus one secondary suite or accessory dwelling unit, depending on zoning.

ALR carriage-house exception (relevant to the rural cards in this feed): for an ALR additional residence, an attached garage is excluded from the total floor area calculation if the additional residence sits on the second storey above a one-storey garage, the garage is for the principal residence's vehicles, its floor area does not exceed the additional residence's maximum (90 m² / 186 m²), there is no internal connection, and the residence is clustered close to the principal residence. The ALR housing frame otherwise allows one principal residence of 500 m² or less, a suite only within it, and one additional residence at 90 m² (≤40 ha) or 186 m² (>40 ha).
Township taxes: Township of Langley property taxes were due Thursday, July 2, 2026; a 5% penalty applies at midnight July 2, 2026, and a further 5% at midnight September 3, 2026.

items.t: The feed's other four second units — garden suite, second home and cabin, barn loft, detached cottage — are each a different legal category from a Township coach house (second storey over a detached garage, s. 102), so the feed label cannot be used as a permit shortcut for any of them.

The Township's own documents conflict on townhouse suites. The January 2025 secondary-suites guide says suites are not permitted in townhouses/rowhouses; the July 2025 s. 102 definition says a suite may be located in a townhouse or rowhouse.

No size cap was found where buyers expect one — and the search has a stated limit. A full-text search of Bylaw 2500's Section 100 found no coach-house size cap in Section 100 itself, but the bylaw's individual zone sections — where such a cap would sit — were not opened, so "no cap anywhere" remains not verified.
The explainer sits where the feed usually sits.

The ALR garage exception has four conditions, not one. Second-storey placement alone does not earn the floor-area exclusion: the garage must be one storey, for the principal residence's vehicles, no larger than the additional residence's own maximum, with no internal connection, and the residence must be clustered close to the principal residence.

Tenure — fee-simple, never strata: the coach house shares the house's fee-simple lot. There is no strata lot to buy, no Form B, no strata fee and no strata bylaw for the unit itself; a buyer who wants the second unit buys the whole parcel. Basis

blocks.text: Local rules that affect land buyers in Langley Houses with Coach Houses

items.t: Coach house tenure, Township s.102: a coach house is a fee-simple second unit on a detached lot under s.102, never strata. It cannot be sold separately from the parcel, and no Form B exists for it.

Suites — Township: Zoning Bylaw s.102, as amended, caps a Township secondary suite at 120 m² with no percentage cap. Sources differ on suites in townhouses: the Township's January 2025 secondary-suites guide states suites are not permitted in townhouses/rowhouses, while the current s.102 definition (July 2025) states a suite may be located in a townhouse or rowhouse. A buyer relying on either point should confirm with the Township.

ALR block (where a property sits on ALR ground — parcel status not verified per parcel): subdivision within the ALR requires Agricultural Land Commission approval; ALR residences cannot be stratified (ALC Bulletin 09 s.6; SPA s.239; ALCA s.21(1)).

Strata block (framework only — a coach-house lot is fee-simple and carries none of this; stated for any bare-land strata lot met elsewhere): Form B within 7 days, max $35 + 25¢/page; depreciation reports on a 5-year cycle for stratas with 5+ lots since July 1, 2024; minimum 10% CRF contribution since November 1, 2023; rental-restriction bylaws void since November 24, 2022; only 55+ age bylaws valid (SPA ss.123.1/123.2 + May 1, 2023 exemptions). A "45+" listing line is not a valid BC age bylaw.
Property taxes — Township: Township of Langley property taxes were due Thursday, July 2, 2026; a 5% penalty applies at midnight July 2, 2026, and a further 5% at midnight September 3, 2026.

blocks.text: Good to know about Langley Houses with Coach Houses

items.t: The definition is narrower than the marketing word (Bylaw 2500 s.102).

The Township contradicts itself in print on townhouse suites — in dated documents. January 2025 guide: not permitted in townhouses/rowhouses. July 2025 s.102 text: may be located in a townhouse or rowhouse, capped at 120 m².

No size cap was found where a cap would first be looked for. A full-text search of Bylaw 2500 Section 100 found no coach-house size cap in Section 100 itself — but the zone sections were not opened, so "no cap anywhere" remains not verified rather than a rule a buyer can rely on.

The ALR garage exception has four conditions, not a vibe. One storey, principal residence's vehicles only, no larger than the additional residence's own maximum, no internal connection, clustered close — miss one and the garage counts in the residence's floor area.
